name: Euharlee
question_title: Can you drive a golf cart in Euharlee?
answer_short: Yes, on city streets in the subdivisions. Golf carts may use public streets posted 25 mph or less. LSVs may use streets posted 35 mph or less. Neither may drive along a state or county highway except to cross.

golf_cart.roads: Public streets posted 25 mph or less

rules.rule: Public streets posted 25 mph or less; not on state or county highways except to cross
Low-speed vehicles on streets posted 35 mph or less; not on state or county highways except to cross

faq.q: Where can I drive my LSV in Euharlee?
faq.a: Streets posted 35 mph or less. Not state or county highways. A town or county can still ban LSVs from a specific road, and posted signs win.

faq.q: Can I drive a golf cart on Euharlee Road?
faq.a: No. It is the state highway through town. Cross it at an intersection.

faq.q: Can I drive a golf cart at night in Euharlee?
faq.a: Only if the cart has working headlights and taillights. Otherwise, sunrise to sunset.
